description: This file defines the MidiConstants class, which contains MIDI-related constant values, masks, message types, lengths, and utility methods for MIDI message processing, based on the MIDI Standard 1.0.

classes.name: MidiConstants
classes.description: Contains MIDI message constants, masks, and static methods for MIDI message processing.

methods.name: getBytesPerMessage
methods.description: Determines the number of bytes in a MIDI message based on the status byte.

methods.name: isAllActiveSensing
methods.description: Checks whether all bytes in a message are Active Sensing signals.
